playback_policy: Opt-in; no automatic playback from the audition page. Gate each cue on its actual event. Label replay.
boundaries: Recorded speech, not a local neural voice model.

136 new clips have captured generation requests; two were recovered from saved Cartesia history with UI metadata. Byte checks and transcript matching do not prove pronunciation or complete audible transcription.
Cue availability does not prove each product event is implemented or connected.
Coverage targets current product scope; future situations may require new lines.

clips.text: Hi, I'm Rowan. What would you like to work on?
clips.trigger: Use when Rowan is introduced at the start of a session.

clips.text: We can start with a task, a question, or a file.
clips.trigger: Use when the user enters Rowan without a specific task yet.

clips.text: Tell me the outcome you want, and I'll shape the run.
clips.trigger: Use when prompting for the desired outcome before planning.

clips.text: A rough prompt is enough. I can help tighten it.

clips.text: I can work from the current workspace when you ask.

clips.text: For public work, I'll keep claims tied to evidence.

clips.text: You can steer or stop me at any point.

clips.text: I can help write, build, check, or explain.

clips.text: We can return to the main thread now.

clips.text: I'll open the source behind that point.

clips.text: I can fall back to another route if this one stalls.
